_note: Code-owned checklists for a human dispatcher. Claude does not write or change these. Nothing here sends or books anything.

Weather.text: Confirm the weather event and affected lanes on the carrier's service-alert page.
Check whether the carrier has published a recovery date for the corridor.
Ask the carrier for a revised delivery estimate in writing.
Tell the customer the delay is weather related and when you will update them next.
Check the contract: weather is often excluded from penalties, so confirm before claiming.

Hub Bottleneck.text: Call the carrier's hub contact and ask for the outbound slot or trailer assignment.
Ask whether the shipment can be pulled from the hub and expedited.
Compare the cost of the ranked mitigation options against the penalty avoided.
Check for other shipments held at the same hub and raise them together.
Tell the customer the last scan, the revised ETA and the next update time.

Customs.text: Check the customs hold reason and any documents the broker is waiting for.
Confirm commercial invoice, HS codes and consignee details are complete.
Contact the broker for a clearance estimate.
Tell the customer a customs hold is in progress and what is needed from them, if anything.
Note the hold start time for any later claim.

Address/Recipient Issue.text: Verify the delivery address and contact details against the order record.
Contact the recipient to confirm availability or correct the address.
Ask the carrier to hold or reattempt delivery with the corrected details.
Record who was contacted and when.
Check whether the delay is the recipient's responsibility before any penalty claim.

Carrier Capacity.text: Ask the carrier when capacity is expected to free up and for a firm ETA.
Price an alternate carrier or expedited service for this shipment.
Check whether the VIP or contract terms allow a different service level.
Tell the customer the new expected date, with the carrier's reason stated plainly.
Log the delay for the carrier's performance review.

Unknown.text: Call the carrier and ask for the exact reason and the next expected scan.
Check the raw event timeline for conflicting or missing scans.
Do not promise a delivery date until the carrier confirms one.
Re-run the analysis after new scans arrive.
Tell the customer you are verifying and when you will follow up.

Generic.text: Open the shipment detail and read the latest scans.
Contact the carrier for the current status and next expected scan.
Review the ranked options and their net benefit.
Decide whether the customer needs an update now.
Record your decision as a disposition on the case.
